# Goalrail

> Evidence-backed inspection for coding-agent environments.

Give a coding agent this site to begin with the supported, authority-bounded
installation path and the current public project state.

- Install: https://goalrail.dev/install.md
- Current state: https://goalrail.dev/status.json
- Source: https://github.com/heurema/goalrail-rs
- Releases: https://github.com/heurema/goalrail-rs/releases

The public CLI provides `gr inspect codex` with skills and plugins drilldowns.
Use the command's JSON evidence and coverage fields before drawing cleanup
conclusions.
